name: Stanford 3D Indoor Spaces Dataset (S3DIS)
description: An indoor scene dataset of six areas across three buildings, providing 3D point-cloud scans and semantic annotations for indoor scene understanding. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Armeni, I., Sener, O., Zamir, A. R., Jiang, H., Brilakis, I., Fischer, M., & Savarese, S. (2016). 3D Semantic Parsing of Large-Scale Indoor Spaces. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 1534–1543. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2016.170
